summary: Implements the `beep lint schema-first` subcommand of the Lint group: it ts-morph-scans the whole repo for schema-first violations (12 SFV4 advisory rules + interface/type-literal/S.Struct candidates + LiteralKit const-assertion errors), diffs the live scan against the committed standards/schema-first.inventory.jsonc baseline under the schema-crispening policy ratchet, optionally rewrites the baseline, and emits both human logs and machine-readable `[schema-first:issue]` JSON lines consumed by Yeet and AgentEffectiveness.

concerns.name: Scan-scope and pattern configuration
concerns.description: Path constants, source globs, and ~20 regex/token constant tables that parameterize every detector (codec helper names, discriminator tokens, numeric-domain tokens, signal patterns).

concerns.name: Schema-first domain models (schemas)
concerns.description: LiteralKit rule/kind/status/family domains plus eight S.Class models and their derived codecs; SchemaFirstPolicyFinding is the machine contract other command groups parse.

concerns.name: Crispening policy ratchet resolution (pure domain logic)
concerns.description: Path-prefix family assignment, owner-override/family blocking resolution, exemption predicate, and the per-rule remediation lookup table.

concerns.name: Inventory/policy jsonc persistence
concerns.description: FileSystem/Path effects that read the jsonc baseline and policy docs (via jsonc-parser) and rewrite the inventory, plus the generatedOn date stamp.

concerns.name: ts-morph project and owner-resolver infrastructure
concerns.description: Builds the repo-wide ts-morph Project from tsconfig + globs and a workspace-package owner resolver that self-admits mirroring Laws/DualArity.makeOwnerResolver (fallow code-duplication waivers inline).

concerns.name: Per-rule AST detectors
concerns.description: The bulk: pure ts-morph node analyzers producing O.Option<SchemaFirstInventoryEntry> per rule (interface/type-alias/struct reasons, numeric-domain, precision-audit, static-api switch, JSON.parse boundary, fn-schema, null-return, normalization, getsomes-struct, defaults, equivalence) plus shared AST helpers.

concerns.name: Schema-arbitrary test-coverage analyzer
concerns.description: Recursive expression walkers that decide whether a schema-heavy test file has schema-derived fast-check property coverage (SFV4-arbitrary-tests), including a standalone in-memory-Project text entry point and the generic literalMemberEquals dual helper.

concerns.name: Repo scan orchestration and inventory diff
concerns.description: The imperative full-repo walk that fans out to every detector per source file, the LiteralKit const-assertion collector, baseline merge, and the missing/stale/candidate/advisory findings computation with policy filtering.

concerns.name: Rendering and machine-readable logging
concerns.description: Console log/error rendering of the summary and each finding class, plus the `[schema-first:issue]` JSON-line emitter that Yeet and AgentEffectiveness parse.

concerns.name: Command wiring
concerns.description: runSchemaFirstLint end-to-end pipeline and the effect/unstable/cli Command definition with the --write flag.

proposedSplit.contents: Keep as the Lint-group subcommand leaf (mirrors sibling SchemaCatalog.ts/SchemaTopology.ts): lintSchemaFirstCommand, runSchemaFirstLint, SchemaFirstLintOptions; shrinks to ~90 LOC composing scan + policy + store + render.

All LiteralKit domains (SchemaFirstPolicyRuleId/EntryKind/EntryStatus/PolicySeverity, SchemaCrispeningFamily) and S.Class models (SchemaFirstInventoryEntry, SchemaFirstPolicyFinding, SchemaFirstInventoryDocument, SchemaFirstLintSummary, SchemaCrispeningFamilyPolicy, SchemaCrispeningPolicyDocument, LiteralKitConstAssertionViolation) plus derived codecs, makeEntryKey, sortEntries, isActiveRuleAdvisory. Keep the existing $I module segment or regenerate the tracked schema catalog.

Earned render role: stringifyJson getters, renderPolicyFindingLine, inventoryEntryFinding, literalKitConstAssertionFinding, logPolicyFinding, makeSchemaFirstLintSummary, logSchemaFirstSummary, and the five log* finding-class emitters. Must preserve the `[schema-first:issue]` line format byte-for-byte.

Crispening ratchet: SCHEMA_CRISPENING_FAMILY_PREFIXES, schemaCrispeningFamilyForFile, resolveSchemaCrispeningPolicyBlocking, isSchemaCrispeningPolicyExempt, MISSING_ENTRY_REMEDIATIONS + missingEntryRemediation (pure, no ts-morph/FS deps; re-exported through the Lint index facade for tests).
jsonc persistence: INVENTORY_PATH/POLICY_PATH, readInventoryDocument, readCrispeningPolicyDocument, writeInventoryDocument, mergeInventory, todayYmd.

Scan-scope infra shared with SchemaCatalog: INCLUDED_GLOBS/SOURCE_FILE_GLOBS, SchemaFirstIncludedGlobs, SchemaFirstSourceFileGlobs, makeSchemaFirstProject, makeSchemaFirstOwnerResolver, isExcludedFile alias.

Per-rule AST detectors and their regex/token constants plus shared AST helpers (isFunctionLocalNode, inferSchemaContainerSymbol, inferExecutableContainerSymbol, propertyNameText, fieldNameTokens): detectInterfaceReason/detectTypeAliasReason/detectStructReason, numericDomain/precisionAudit/staticApi/boundaryCodec/fnSchema/nullReturn/normalization/getsomesStruct/defaults/equivalence entry builders, and the sourceHas*Signal fast-path predicates.

SFV4-arbitrary-tests analyzer cluster: SCHEMA_CODEC_HELPERS, isSchemaFirstTestFile, isSchemaCodecCallExpression, the schema-arbitrary expression walkers, sourceHasSchemaArbitraryPropertyCoverage, sourceTextHasSchemaArbitraryPropertyCoverage, arbitraryTestsEntryFromSourceFile, and literalMemberEquals (until promoted to @beep/utils).

Orchestration: scanSchemaFirstInventory (the per-file detector fan-out loop), collectLiteralKitConstAssertionViolations, SchemaFirstLintFindings type (keep non-exported from the facade), inventoryEntriesByKey/trackedInventoryEntriesByKey/staleInventoryEntries, collectSchemaFirstLintFindings, schemaFirstLintHasFailures.

sharedCandidates.description: Yeet/internal/QualityIssueIndex.ts (SchemaFirstPolicyOutput, line 105) and AgentEffectiveness/internal/EvalScorer.ts (SchemaFirstPolicyIssue, line 306) each redeclare a structural copy of this schema to parse the emitted JSON lines. Exporting the finding schema plus line prefix from one shared contract module removes the triplication and makes format drift a type error.
Fully generic dual-arity literal-membership check (A.some + Str.Equivalence) with zero schema-first coupling; already consumed by SchemaCatalog.ts. Belongs in @beep/utils next to A helpers.
alsoUsefulFor: any group matching literal token lists

sharedCandidates.description: Workspace-path -> package-owner resolver that its own comment admits mirrors Laws/DualArity.makeOwnerResolver (line 863 there), with fallow code-duplication waivers papering over the copy. Promote to src/internal/repo-run (or a shared internal/Ownership.ts) and delete both copies.
Generic repo-wide ts-morph Project factory (tsconfig + glob set); only the glob constant is schema-first-specific. Parameterize the globs and it serves every ts-morph-scanning command.
Repo test-file classification (test/spec patterns minus generated/dist/dtslint segments) is not schema-first-specific.
Generic UTC YYYY-MM-DD stamp built on effect DateTime; useful anywhere generatedOn fields are written.

risks: Facade contract: commands/Lint/index.ts re-exports 15 named symbols from ./SchemaFirst.ts and test/schema-first.test.ts imports 9 of them via @beep/repo-cli/commands/Lint; JSDoc @example blocks also import from that facade and docgen compiles them - every moved public symbol must keep its facade re-export or tests and docgen break.

In-group direct imports use explicit .ts specifiers: SchemaCatalog.ts:21 imports literalMemberEquals/makeSchemaFirstOwnerResolver/SchemaFirstIncludedGlobs and Lint.command.ts:26 imports lintSchemaFirstCommand from "./SchemaFirst.ts" - both must be retargeted in the same change.

Machine contract: the `[schema-first:issue] {json}` stderr line (renderPolicyFindingLine + encoded SchemaFirstPolicyFinding shape) is parsed by Yeet/internal/QualityIssueIndex.ts and AgentEffectiveness/internal/EvalScorer.ts and asserted in yeet.test.ts; the render split must not change prefix, field names, or severity semantics.

Self-referential lint: this lint scans its own package, and inventory keys embed file paths; new split files must not introduce exported type-literals, S.Struct calls, or null-return helpers that create untracked findings (keep SchemaFirstLintFindings non-exported), or `bun run beep lint schema-first` fails until a --write refresh of standards/schema-first.inventory.jsonc.

$I identity churn: $RepoCliId.create("commands/Lint/SchemaFirst") feeds schema identifiers for 8 S.Class models, and the p3 schema catalog is generated AND tracked (commit 5783560); giving moved schemas a new $I module segment changes catalog entries, so either keep the segment string or regenerate/commit the catalog in the same PR.

Ordering/state seams: scanSchemaFirstInventory and collectLiteralKitConstAssertionViolations each build a fresh whole-repo ts-morph Project (expensive, process.cwd()-relative); splitting must not accidentally share one mutable Project across detectors or change the dedupe/sort order (makeEntryKey-based) that keeps the committed inventory diff-stable.
